name: @ycpiglet/editorial-publishing-kit
description: Composable contracts, profiles, templates, and tooling for consistent editorial publishing projects.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p studio/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-repository.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run studio:build
scripts.studio: npm run build --silent && npm run studio:build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js studio
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run studio:build
